Name: SpiralArms
Label: Arms
Description: Controls how many parallel arms run through the spiral.

Name: SpiralTurns
Label: Turns
Description: Controls how many times the arm winds from the center toward the edge.

Name: SpiralThickness
Label: Band thickness
Description: Controls the width of the solid part of each spiral band.

Name: SpiralSoftness
Label: Band softness
Description: Controls how gently each spiral band fades into its surroundings.

Name: SpiralRotation
Label: Rotation
Description: Rotates the spiral around its center in degrees.

Name: SpiralInvert
Label: Invert
Description: Swaps the spiral bands and the space between them.
